advanced.highlight.rgbWithoutFunctionLan: Languages for the bare RGB mode.

advanced.info.showDiagnostics: Show parser notes in the hover.

config.advanced:
Incremental overrides for the built-in options. Keys are **flat dotted paths**; omitted keys keep their default. The 8 top-level settings must not appear here.

Tip: type `"` inside the object for completion, or pick the "All advanced options" snippet to insert every key with its default.

| Key | Type / values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Highlight** | | | |
| `highlight.markRuler` | `boolean` | `true` | Show a marker in the overview ruler. |
| `highlight.matchWords` | `off` \| `css-like` \| `all` | `"css-like"` | Where to recognise color names: nowhere, CSS-like languages only, or every language. |
| `highlight.hexAlphaOrder` | `rgba` \| `argb` | `"rgba"` | Interpretation of eight digit hex: #RRGGBBAA or #AARRGGBB. |
| `highlight.matchRgbWithoutFunction` | `boolean` | `false` | Recognise bare "255, 136, 0" as an RGB color. |
| `highlight.rgbWithoutFunctionLanguages` | `string[]` | `["*"]` | Languages for the bare RGB mode. |
| `highlight.matchHslWithoutFunction` | `boolean` | `false` | Recognise bare "30, 100%, 50%" as an HSL color. |
| `highlight.hslWithoutFunctionLanguages` | `string[]` | `["*"]` | Languages for the bare HSL mode. |
| `highlight.maxMatchesPerDocument` | `integer` (1–1000000) | `10000` | Stop highlighting after this many colors in one document. |
| `highlight.hdrToneMapping` | `none` \| `reinhard` \| `clip` | `"reinhard"` | Tone mapping used to preview HDR colors in sRGB. |
| **Color picker** | | | |
| `colorPicker.mode` | `off` \| `dedupe` \| `all` | `"dedupe"` | Native inline swatch and hover color picker (the picker is anchored on the swatch, so both come together). "dedupe" probes the other color providers in css/less/scss and only fills the gaps, so no color ever gets two swatches; "all" reports every supported syntax everywhere. |
| **Fields (hover + highlight)** | | | |
| `fields.enabled` | `string[]` \| `null` | `null` | Ordered list of color fields. Drives both the hover rows and which color syntax is highlighted. null uses the default order. |
| `fields.excluded` | `string[]` | `[]` | Color fields to turn off. Exclusions win over the field list. Turning off a syntax also stops highlighting it. |
| **Hover** | | | |
| `info.previewSize` | `small` \| `large` | `"small"` | Size of the hover color swatch. |
| `info.previewShape` | `square` \| `rectangle` | `"rectangle"` | Shape of the hover color swatch. |
| `info.showDiagnostics` | `boolean` | `true` | Show parser notes in the hover. |
| `info.showSpecLevel` | `boolean` | `true` | Show which specification level a syntax comes from. |
| **Convert** | | | |
| `convert.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable the conversion commands. |
| `convert.alphaLoss` | `reject` \| `confirm` \| `drop` | `"reject"` | What to do when the target format cannot express alpha. |
| `convert.missingComponentLoss` | `confirm` \| `compute` | `"confirm"` | What to do when "none" components cannot be preserved. |
| `convert.namedColorFallback` | `reject` \| `nearest` | `"reject"` | What to do when no color name matches exactly. |
| `convert.recentFirst` | `boolean` | `true` | Put recently used target formats at the top of the picker. |
| **Output** | | | |
| `output.gamutMapping` | `css` \| `clip` \| `none` | `"css"` | Gamut mapping strategy for sRGB output. |
| `output.hexCase` | `lower` \| `upper` | `"lower"` | Letter case of generated hex values. |
| **Scan** | | | |
| `scan.comments` | `boolean` | `true` | Scan comments for colors. |
| `scan.strings` | `boolean` | `true` | Scan string literals for colors. |
| `scan.maxDocumentSizeKb` | `integer` (1–102400) | `2048` | Skip documents larger than this size. |
| **Other** | | | |
| `contextualPreview` | `off` \| `auto` \| `light` \| `dark` | `"auto"` | Color scheme assumed when previewing context dependent colors such as light-dark(). "auto" follows the editor theme. Results are marked as assumed. |
| **Variables** | | | |
| `variables.resolve` | `boolean` | `true` | Resolve CSS custom properties and preprocessor variables. |
| `variables.includePaths` | `string[]` | `[]` | Extra workspace relative search paths for imports. |
| `variables.maxImportDepth` | `integer` (0–100) | `20` | Maximum import depth. |
| `variables.maxImportFiles` | `integer` (0–10000) | `200` | Maximum number of imported files. |
| `variables.maxResolveDepth` | `integer` (1–100) | `20` | Maximum variable resolution depth. |
| **Experimental** | | | |
| `experimental.hdrAssumedHeadroom` | `number` (0–10) | `0` | Assumed display HDR headroom used to preview hdr-color(). 0 disables the preview. |
| **Coexistence** | | | |
| `coexistence.notify` | `boolean` | `true` | Warn when the original three color extensions are also installed. |
| **Other** | | | |
| `logLevel` | `off` \| `error` \| `warn` \| `info` \| `debug` | `"warn"` | Verbosity of the output channel. |
config.convertSyntax: Output style for rgb() and hsl().
config.experimental: Draft specifications to enable. Both are on by default.
config.highlight: Color highlight style. "square-before" / "square-after" draw a filled swatch, "dot-before" / "dot-after" a bullet. "off" disables highlighting.
config.languages: Languages to process. Use a language id, "*" for all, or "!id" to exclude. Exclusions win over inclusions.
config.precision: Number of significant digits in generated color values.
extension.description: Color highlighting, hover information and format conversion with CSS Color 4/5/6 and HDR support.
